name: Roughrider Coin
oneLiner: Roughrider is the pre-launch Bank of North Dakota / Fiserv bank-to-bank pilot stablecoin, planned 1:1 USD-backed by deposits and short U.S. Treasury notes.
collateral: Planned Bank of North Dakota / Fiserv reserve backing with deposits and U.S. Treasury notes with maturities no longer than 93 days, maintained 1:1 with the stablecoin during the bank-to-bank beta
pegMechanism: Pre-launch bank-to-bank payment stablecoin pilot: BND and Fiserv plan a 1:1 USD-denominated token for North Dakota financial institutions, with public access and production contract details still unavailable
launchPhaseDetail: IC unanimously approved bank-to-bank pilot March 25; risk rated low-to-moderate; 10 local banks interested; cost-neutral model; Fiserv contract negotiations still ongoing (not yet signed). Roughrider will be the first white-label deployment on Fiserv's FIUSD platform (Solana); FIUSD itself slipped from end-2025 to July 2026 (Fiserv CEO, June 3 2026), compressing the runway to Roughrider's September 2026 pilot target, which remains planned

featuredContent.description: North Dakota's first stablecoin — fully USD-backed, built on Fiserv's digital asset platform, targeting bank-to-bank transactions for 2026 launch.
